<span class="dot" aria-hidden="true" data-astro-cid-cid5>
</span>Neural data infrastructure</p> <h1 id="h-hero" data-astro-cid-cid5>The data layer for <em>brain-computer interfaces.</em>
</h1> <p class="nf-lede" data-astro-cid-cid5>Versioned, comparable pipelines and neural-data governance, from electrode to model.</p> <div class="ctas" data-astro-cid-cid5>
<span class="nf-btn-wrap" data-astro-cid-cid14>

</span>

</div> <p class="formats" data-astro-cid-cid5> <span class="nf-visually-hidden" data-astro-cid-cid5>Open data formats and protocols the platform is designed for: </span> Designed for <b data-astro-cid-cid5>BIDS</b>
<span aria-hidden="true" data-astro-cid-cid5> · </span>
<b data-astro-cid-cid5>LSL</b>
<span aria-hidden="true" data-astro-cid-cid5> · </span>
<b data-astro-cid-cid5>EDF/BDF</b>

<b data-astro-cid-cid5>NWB</b>
<span aria-hidden="true" data-astro-cid-cid5> · </span>
<b data-astro-cid-cid5>XDF</b> <span class="fnote" data-astro-cid-cid5> Open formats and protocols, not partners.</span> </p> </div>  </div> <div class="stage" data-astro-cid-cid5>

</div> </div> </section>  <section class="nf-section" id="platform" aria-labelledby="h-plat" data-astro-cid-cid19> <div class="nf-wrap" data-astro-cid-cid19> <div class="sec-head" data-astro-cid-cid13> <p class="nf-label" data-astro-cid-cid13>
<span class="nf-so" data-n="01" aria-hidden="true" data-astro-cid-cid10>
</span> 01 · Platform</p> <div data-astro-cid-cid13> <h2 id="h-plat" data-astro-cid-cid13="true">One pipeline, <em>from electrode to model.</em>
</h2> <p class="nf-lede" data-astro-cid-cid13>Four stages. Every run is versioned, and every parameter, version and input hash is recorded as provenance.</p> </div> </div>  <ol class="pipe" data-astro-cid-cid6> <li class="step" id="step-ingest" data-astro-cid-cid6> <span class="node" aria-hidden="true" data-astro-cid-cid6>
</span> <span class="num" data-astro-cid-cid6>01 / Ingest</span> <h3 data-astro-cid-cid6>Hardware-agnostic ingest</h3> <p data-astro-cid-cid6>Connectors for EEG, ECoG and microelectrode recordings in open formats, stored on standard time-series infrastructure.</p> <ul data-astro-cid-cid6>
<li data-astro-cid-cid6>BIDS</li>
<li data-astro-cid-cid6>Lab Streaming Layer</li>
<li data-astro-cid-cid6>EDF/BDF · NWB · XDF</li>
</ul> <p class="st" data-astro-cid-cid6>
<span class="pill pill--designed" data-astro-cid-cid15>
<span class="nf-visually-hidden" data-astro-cid-cid15>Status: </span>Designed</span>
</p> </li>
<li class="step" id="step-pipelines" data-astro-cid-cid6> <span class="node" aria-hidden="true" data-astro-cid-cid6>
</span> <span class="num" data-astro-cid-cid6>02 / Pipelines</span> <h3 data-astro-cid-cid6>Reproducible, comparable pipelines</h3> <p data-astro-cid-cid6>Versioned preprocessing pipelines with full provenance. Run one, or run a grid of them and see how your results move.</p> <ul data-astro-cid-cid6>
<li data-astro-cid-cid6>Pinned versions</li>
<li data-astro-cid-cid6>Parameter provenance</li>
<li data-astro-cid-cid6>Pipeline grids</li>
</ul> <p class="st" data-astro-cid-cid6>
<span class="pill pill--designed" data-astro-cid-cid15>
<span class="nf-visually-hidden" data-astro-cid-cid15>Status: </span>Designed</span>
</p> </li>
<li class="step" id="step-models" data-astro-cid-cid6> <span class="node" aria-hidden="true" data-astro-cid-cid6>
</span> <span class="num" data-astro-cid-cid6>03 / Neuro-AI</span> <h3 data-astro-cid-cid6>Governed model registry</h3> <p data-astro-cid-cid6>Governed model registry (roadmap): versioned models with provenance, documented intended use and use restrictions. Benchmarks will be published with methods.</p> <ul data-astro-cid-cid6>
<li data-astro-cid-cid6>Versioned models</li>
<li data-astro-cid-cid6>Intended use</li>
<li data-astro-cid-cid6>Use restrictions</li>
</ul> <p class="st" data-astro-cid-cid6>
<span class="pill pill--roadmap" data-astro-cid-cid15>
<span class="nf-visually-hidden" data-astro-cid-cid15>Status: </span>Roadmap</span>
</p> </li>
<li class="step" id="step-sdks" data-astro-cid-cid6> <span class="node" aria-hidden="true" data-astro-cid-cid6>
</span> <span class="num" data-astro-cid-cid6>04 / SDKs</span> <h3 data-astro-cid-cid6>Python first, one shared core</h3> <p data-astro-cid-cid6>A Python SDK first, built on one shared core so every language records provenance the same way. C and C++ bindings follow; game engines on request.</p> <ul data-astro-cid-cid6>
<li data-astro-cid-cid6>Python</li>
<li data-astro-cid-cid6>C / C++</li>
<li data-astro-cid-cid6>Unity / Unreal on request</li>
</ul> <p class="st" data-astro-cid-cid6>
<span class="pill pill--planned" data-astro-cid-cid15>
<span class="nf-visually-hidden" data-astro-cid-cid15>Status: </span>Planned</span>
</p> </li> </ol> <div class="code" data-astro-cid-cid6> <div class="explain" data-astro-cid-cid6>  <h3 data-astro-cid-cid6>Every run carries its provenance.</h3> <p data-astro-cid-cid6>Open a recording, run a pinned pipeline version, and get a provenance handle that records every parameter, version and input hash.</p> </div> <pre aria-label="Illustrative Python example" tabindex="0" data-astro-cid-cid6>
<code data-astro-cid-cid6>import {brand.codeIdentifiers.pythonImport} as nf            # Illustrative API, subject to change
rec = nf.open(&quot;sub-01_task-motor_eeg.edf&quot;)
run = nf.pipelines.get(&quot;eeg-basic@1.0.0&quot;).run(rec)
print(run.provenance.id)          # every parameter, version and input hash</code>
<span class="cnote" data-astro-cid-cid6>Illustrative API, subject to change</span>
</pre> </div>  <div class="evidence" data-astro-cid-cid17>  <ol data-astro-cid-cid17> <li data-astro-cid-cid17> <span class="t" data-astro-cid-cid17>In a 2025 study, every artifact-correction step reduced decoding performance.</span> <span class="src" data-astro-cid-cid17> <span class="grade" data-astro-cid-cid17>[A]</span> <a href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s42003-025-08464-3" rel="noopener noreferrer" data-astro-cid-cid17>market/landscape.md §3</a> </span> </li>
<li data-astro-cid-cid17> <span class="t" data-astro-cid-cid17>A 2025 comparison of 43 preprocessing pipelines found no single best pipeline.</span> <span class="src" data-astro-cid-cid17> <span class="grade" data-astro-cid-cid17>[A]</span> <a href="https://doi.org/10.1111/psyp.70197" rel="noopener noreferrer" data-astro-cid-cid17>market/landscape.md §3</a> </span> </li> </ol> </div>  </div> </section> <section class="nf-section band" id="governance" aria-labelledby="h-gov" data-astro-cid-cid19> <div class="nf-wrap" data-astro-cid-cid19> <div class="sec-head" data-astro-cid-cid13> <p class="nf-label" data-astro-cid-cid13>
<span class="nf-so" data-n="02" aria-hidden="true" data-astro-cid-cid10>
</span> 02 · Governance</p> <div data-astro-cid-cid13> <h2 id="h-gov" data-astro-cid-cid13="true">Neural-data law is here. <em>Govern the data, not just the files.</em>
</h2> <p class="nf-lede" data-astro-cid-cid13>US states define neural data differently, so one recording can be regulated in one state and not in the next. Classification, consent and deletion have to follow the data into every derivative.</p> </div> </div>  <ul class="points" data-astro-cid-cid19> <li class="nf-card" data-astro-cid-cid19>
<h3 data-astro-cid-cid19>Per-jurisdiction classification</h3>
<p data-astro-cid-cid19>Each channel and derived feature is classified against each state&#39;s definition.</p>
<span class="pill pill--planned" data-astro-cid-cid15>
<span class="nf-visually-hidden" data-astro-cid-cid15>Status: </span>Planned</span>
</li>
<li class="nf-card" data-astro-cid-cid19>
<h3 data-astro-cid-cid19>Versioned consent ledger</h3>
<p data-astro-cid-cid19>Opt-in consent recorded with its version, and withdrawal propagated to raw data, derivatives and trained models.</p>
<span class="pill pill--planned" data-astro-cid-cid15>
<span class="nf-visually-hidden" data-astro-cid-cid15>Status: </span>Planned</span>
</li>
<li class="nf-card" data-astro-cid-cid19>
<h3 data-astro-cid-cid19>Use restrictions on models</h3>
<p data-astro-cid-cid19>Models carry intended-use and use-restriction metadata, for example for EU workplace and education settings.</p>
<span class="pill pill--planned" data-astro-cid-cid15>
<span class="nf-visually-hidden" data-astro-cid-cid15>Status: </span>Planned</span>
</li> </ul> <p class="more" data-astro-cid-cid19>
<a href="/law-tracker" data-astro-cid-cid19>Read the neural-data law tracker</a>
</p> <div class="evidence" data-astro-cid-cid17>  <ol data-astro-cid-cid17> <li data-astro-cid-cid17> <span class="t" data-astro-cid-cid17>Colorado, California, Montana and Connecticut have passed laws that add neural data to the sensitive data their privacy laws protect; Connecticut&#39;s amendments carry July 1, 2026 effective dates.</span> <span class="src" data-astro-cid-cid17> <span class="grade" data-astro-cid-cid17>[A]</span> <span data-astro-cid-cid17>market/regulation.md §1</span> </span> </li>
<li data-astro-cid-cid17> <span class="t" data-astro-cid-cid17>Colorado and California cover the central or peripheral nervous system; Connecticut covers the central nervous system only; California excludes data inferred from non-neural information.</span> <span class="src" data-astro-cid-cid17> <span class="grade" data-astro-cid-cid17>[A]</span> <span data-astro-cid-cid17>market/regulation.md §1</span> </span> </li> </ol> </div>  </div> </section> <section class="nf-section" id="audience" aria-labelledby="h-aud" data-astro-cid-cid19> <div class="nf-wrap" data-astro-cid-cid19> <div class="sec-head" data-astro-cid-cid13> <p class="nf-label" data-astro-cid-cid13>
<span class="nf-so" data-n="03" aria-hidden="true" data-astro-cid-cid10>
</span> 03 · Who it is for</p> <div data-astro-cid-cid13> <h2 id="h-aud" data-astro-cid-cid13="true">Built for labs <em>and for device makers.</em>
</h2> <p class="nf-lede" data-astro-cid-cid13>The same provenance and governance layer, packaged for two different jobs.</p> </div> </div>  <div class="tabs-root" data-nf-tabs data-astro-cid-cid7> <div class="tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Who it is for" data-astro-cid-cid7> <button type="button" role="tab" id="aud-tab-researchers" aria-controls="aud-panel-researchers" aria-selected="true" tabindex="0" data-astro-cid-cid7>For researchers</button>

</h3> <p data-astro-cid-cid7>Open your lab&#39;s recordings in a pipeline that other labs can re-run exactly, and compare pipelines instead of trusting one default.</p> <span class="nf-btn-wrap" data-astro-cid-cid14>

<span class="nf-so" data-n="04" aria-hidden="true" data-astro-cid-cid10>
</span> 04 · Compliance &amp; security</p> <div data-astro-cid-cid13> <h2 id="h-sec" data-astro-cid-cid13="true">Neural data is sensitive. <em>Our design starts there.</em>
</h2> <p class="nf-lede" data-astro-cid-cid13>Controls listed with their current status. We hold no certifications and claim none.</p> </div> </div>  <div class="grid-wrap" data-astro-cid-cid12> <svg class="nf-sv" role="img" aria-label="Illustration of layered data protection: encryption, access control and audit logging." viewBox="0 0 480 150" preserveAspectRatio="xMinYMid meet" data-astro-cid-cid11> <rect class="frame" x="0.5" y="0.5" width="479" height="149" rx="6" data-astro-cid-cid11>

<h3 id="paper-somatosensory-closed-loop" data-astro-cid-cid18="true">
<a href="/research/somatosensory-closed-loop" data-astro-cid-cid18>Bidirectional closed-loop somatosensory feedback: a computational study</a>
</h3>
<p data-astro-cid-cid18>Modelling how patterned stimulation of somatosensory cortex could encode touch, pressure and proprioception.</p>

<h3 id="paper-preprocessing-multiverse" data-astro-cid-cid18="true">How preprocessing choices change decoding results: a multiverse analysis on public EEG</h3>
<p class="kind nf-label" data-astro-cid-cid18>Methods study</p>
